name: cli-engine-english-glossary-standardization
title: Standardize cli-engine English translation manifest (glossary, CLI style, behavior-safe regex)
description: Follow-up to B-8448. The cli-engine English execution plan's 762-row translation manifest (docs/requirements/decisions/cli-engine-english-open-source-execution-plan.md) is complete but its proposedEnglish drafts are not internally consistent: core terms vary (blocked/forbidden/excluded, source of truth vs truth source, round vs iteration, Story/story), some command descriptions are too long for the lattice help list (longest 218 chars), wrapped multi-line source lines are translated as disjoint fragments (M004/M005), and several rows are not prose but behavior-sensitive regex code (M668/M669 match Chinese strings at runtime). This story establishes a fixed English glossary + CLI style guide and applies it across all 762 manifest rows and the T-table catalog, shortens over-long command descriptions, defines a wrapped-source merge rule, and isolates behavior-sensitive rows so they are gated with tests rather than treated as translation. The term 'real-machine tests' is kept as-is (established code identifier realMachineTests, 37 references). No cli-engine.ts source is changed; the deliverable remains the reviewable plan document, rows stay review-draft.
